description: User observed 5 'replacing log candidates that failed to lock' lines in 2ms, each naming a different fresh worker id for the SAME ghost. Two defects: (1) the Logger.info fires before creation — under rapid attempt stalls (foreman not yet ready) the announced workers never existed; log after success instead. (2) The director relearns the same ghost every attempt: lock failures are only pruned from the view at recovery COMPLETION. RecoveryAttempt now accumulates lock_failed_service_ids across attempts and refresh_available_services excludes them, so a ghost trips exactly one attempt per director; previously created replacements that did register are then reused as ordinary candidates instead of creating more.
title: Lock-failed services are remembered across recovery attempts; replacement logged after the fact
